text: The exhibition "Living Hands: Heritage and Design in Dialogue" opened on Tuesday, at the Al-Bireh Cultural Center, celebrating six endangered Palestinian traditional crafts and the artisans who keep them alive: glassblowing, pottery, olivewood carving, mother-of-pearl inlay, loom weaving (Majdalawi and Baladi), and bamboo (reed) weaving. The exhibition runs in Al-Bireh until 20 October 2026 and will then move to Bethlehem on 5 November 2026.
